title: DDB.OS graph table build

turns.text: I want the chat organizer to live inside DDB.OS, not as a separate service. One new table set on the existing SQLite DB.
We decided tags and links are JSON columns on the graph row, not join tables. One row per node is the whole node.
The graph table must have canon_id as its primary key, and graph_fts must stay in lockstep with it.
TODO: add the two read endpoints to the Flask app at 127.0.0.1:8410.
Should we build the standalone offline fallback now, or defer it?
The retrieval layer depends on [[COS_Root_Organizer_Protocol]] for its trigger phrasings.
